cases.given: a bottle event with amount 100 ml created in operation one
cases.when: operation two sets its amount to 120 ml
expect: the operation log still contains both operations
the current-record projection shows amount 120 ml
replaying the log reproduces the same projection

cases.given: a visible event and its creation operation
cases.when: a later delete operation sets its tombstone
expect: the creation and delete remain in the operation log
the event is absent from the visible timeline
replaying the log reproduces the same projection

cases.given: the current date is later than the activity date
cases.when: a member logs an activity that happened earlier
expect: the timeline places the event on its activity date
the new operation carries the current merge clock

cases.given: a child activity that was deleted and remains in the operation log
cases.when: its original Family and child append a restore operation
expect: the same activity ID and saved fields return to the visible timeline
the delete and restore both remain in the operation log
another device that verifies the restore sees the same activity
a wrong Family or child cannot restore the activity
restoring an activity that is already visible is rejected

cases.given: a breast feed started on the left, paused, and resumed on the right
cases.when: the caregiver saves it and later corrects a side duration
expect: the pause remains a gap between ordered nonoverlapping segments
left and right totals exclude the pause
the correction keeps the activity ID, child, Family, and original start
restart and replay preserve the corrected segment list
